boards.title: Your First Weekend at Niagara University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that begins on campus and pairs familiar Niagara spaces with nearby public attractions.

cards.title: Start at the Gallagher Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus student center
cards.notes: Use the lower-level lounge as a first meeting point, then check the posted Campus Activities information before choosing the rest of your evening.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus rendezvous point with student-life offices and lounge space.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara identifies the lower level of the Gallagher Center as a place for students to eat, meet classmates, study, and relax; it also houses Campus Activities.
cards.access_notes: University student-center space; check campus access and event schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Clet Hall
cards.notes: Meet your new group over dinner in Clet Hall, and review the current Metz hours before going so the stop fits the academic-calendar schedule.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining stop with daily vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara says the Dining Commons is in Clet Hall and offers all-you-can-eat options, with vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options offered daily.
cards.access_notes: Meals and operating hours are managed through Niagara Dining Services; confirm current hours on the linked Metz site.

cards.title: Check the Friday Late Nite Niagara program
cards.subtitle: Friday night • Gallagher Center Multi-Purpose Room
cards.notes: Look for that week’s Campus Activities listing and join the scheduled Friday program if it matches your interests; bring friends rather than going alone.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Friday-night campus-programming series in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara identifies the Gallagher Center Multi-Purpose Room as the primary home for its Late Nite Niagara programming series, held every Friday night during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Recurring during the academic year; consult Campus Activities for the specific program, time, and entry requirements.

cards.title: Pause at Alumni Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Niagara University campus
cards.notes: Take a quiet campus pause, or attend a listed service if it aligns with your plans and beliefs; verify the current schedule before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel used for worship, reflection, and university gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara states that Sunday Mass is celebrated in Alumni Chapel during the semester and lists weekday and summer services; its facilities page identifies Alumni Chapel as a campus space.
cards.source_title: So Much to Do | Niagara University
cards.access_notes: Service schedules can change by semester and season; confirm with Campus Ministry before planning around a service.

cards.title: Try the exhibits at Niagara Power Vista
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • beside campus on Lewiston Road
cards.notes: Explore the interactive exhibits and observation area, then use the visit to orient yourself to the Niagara River’s hydropower story.
cards.short_summary: A nearby hydropower visitor center with free admission and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York Power Authority lists Niagara Power Vista at 5777 Lewiston Road, open seven days a week from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. except certain holidays, with free admission and parking.
cards.source_title: Niagara Power Vista | New York Power Authority
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 9 a.m.–5 p.m. daily, with certain holiday closures; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Use the rim overlooks at Whirlpool State Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Niagara Gorge
cards.notes: Stay on the upper-level overlooks and marked paths for river views; check the trail notice first and skip closed or unstable gorge routes.
cards.short_summary: A year-round state park with overlooks, picnic areas, and Niagara Gorge trails.
cards.evidence_claim: New York State Parks says Whirlpool State Park is open year-round from dawn to dusk, has no vehicle entrance fee, and offers scenic overlooks at street level.
cards.source_title: Whirlpool State Park | NYS Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk. Review the official page’s active trail-closure notices and remain on open marked routes.

cards.title: Walk into Niagara Falls State Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon • Niagara Falls, New York
cards.notes: Choose a well-marked walking route and take in the falls from the public park, leaving time to return before your transportation plan ends.
cards.short_summary: A public state-park visit centered on viewing the falls without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara Falls State Park states that it is open 365 days a year and is always free to walk into the park and experience the falls.
cards.source_title: Park Information | Niagara Falls State Park
cards.access_notes: The park is open year-round; check current weather, park notices, and transportation arrangements before departure.

cards.title: Reserve Cave of the Winds if you want a ticketed add-on
cards.subtitle: Saturday • Goat Island, Niagara Falls State Park
cards.notes: Book a timed ticket if the weather and schedule work, wear footwear that can get wet, and keep this as an optional paid portion of the outing.
cards.short_summary: A timed-ticket attraction that takes visitors to the Hurricane Deck near the falls.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara Falls State Park describes Cave of the Winds as a timed-ticket attraction on Goat Island, open daily year-round, with footwear that may get wet recommended.
cards.source_title: Cave of the Winds | Niagara Falls State Park
cards.access_notes: Timed tickets are sold at Cave of the Winds or the Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Welcome Center; its schedule and last-ticket times vary by date.

cards.title: Make Sunday an Aquarium of Niagara visit
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime • 701 Whirlpool Street, Niagara Falls
cards.notes: Choose an entry window online or at the door, and plan enough time to see both the Main Building and Great Lakes 360 on one admission.
cards.short_summary: A two-building aquarium visit that includes Great Lakes 360 with general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aquarium of Niagara says general admission includes both its Main Building and Great Lakes 360; tickets are available online and on-site, with weekend hours listed as 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Sunday hours are listed as 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; last ticket is sold one hour before closing. Check holiday exceptions before visiting.

cards.title: Finish with a Kiernan Recreation Center reset
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening • Niagara University campus
cards.notes: Bring the required credentials, choose an available activity, and make this a low-key close to the weekend rather than a strenuous first-day commitment.
cards.short_summary: Niagara’s campus recreation complex for fitness, pool, court, and wellness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara describes the Kiernan Recreation Center as an all-in-one recreation complex with more than 50 intramural, recreational, and health/wellness programs for the university community.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours are listed as 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–9 p.m. Friday, and 9 a.m.–9 p.m. weekends; access may be restricted for scheduled activities.
